item.subject: science
item.stem: In her school laboratory in Pune, Meena passes an electric current through water containing a little dilute sulphuric acid. She collects two gases in separate test tubes. One gas burns with a pop sound near a flame, and the other makes a glowing splint relight. What do these results show about water?

options.A: Water is a mixture of hydrogen and oxygen gases that can be separated by filtering.
options.B: Water is an element because it produces gases when electricity passes through it.
options.C: Water is a compound made of hydrogen and oxygen chemically joined together.
options.D: Water is a pure substance that contains only oxygen atoms.
